mission: BlueDot runs free online courses (e.g. 'The Future of AI'), grants and intensive in-person programs, describing itself as 'the leading talent accelerator for beneficial AI and societal resilience.' It says that since 2022 it has trained over 10,000 professionals and that 25% of graduates land impactful roles within six months.

key_work.title: The Future of AI (free course)
key_work.plain_summary: A free, self-paced two-hour course giving a clear picture of frontier AI and how to help.

warnings.text: 'Humanity is building something smarter and more powerful than itself.' AI could cure diseases and end poverty, but 'could also cause catastrophes we can't recover from.'
'Only a few thousand people are working to make it go well.'

recommendations.text: Get many more capable people working on AI safety through free courses, funding and in-person programs.
Help graduates move fast into impactful roles at labs, governments and nonprofits.
